open.transcript: A reliable voyage begins long before a vessel leaves port.

brand.transcript: For Libraa, that work has been our business since 2009.

services.transcript: From ship management and surveys to repairs, new build supervision and offshore services, we support vessels from shore to sea and recruit the seafarers who operate them.

map.transcript: From our head office in Chennai and offices in Kakinada and Port Blair, we work across 8 locations around India's coasts.

fleet.transcript: We have managed and worked on vessels of every kind, tugs, dredgers and passenger ferries under Indian and Gabonese flags. Here are just a few.

hero.transcript: And one of them, Koundinya, we built from scratch in Kakinada.

field.transcript: From Indian ports to West Africa, every job starts the same way: a toolbox talk and the right safety gear for everyone.

companies.transcript: 3 group companies, each responsible for its own part of the business, backed by 4 certifications and licenses.

clients.transcript: We are proud to serve the Indian Navy, Adani Ports and JSW, alongside port authorities, energy groups and shipping houses.

end.transcript: Libra Group, ship management, crew management and marine services.
